title: Clover Pendulum
description: Three spacious bass steps support a long G-major song. In the central span four dotted pulses move beneath three equal melodic notes, so the two hands meet only at the bar line. The final return enlarges the bass to two gestures and finishes a bar earlier than the opening suggests.
technical_note: Maintain the six-quarter span through the central four-against-three passage. Keep the melody singing and the dotted bass quiet; the final two-pulse ground should feel broader without an abrupt tempo change.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
